name: Bloodmage: every Blood Orb pickup adds a Darkcasting stack (#12980)
contract: #12980: Darkcasting 712383 has StackAmount 10 and its tooltip reads 'Each Blood Orb collected allows you to
spawn 1 Blood Worm when you use your next Animated Blood. Stacks $u times.' In game every pickup refreshed
it at 1 stack. Pickup spell 712419 is a SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL for 712383, which
Spell::EffectTriggerSpell runs at launch-target; because 712383 needs an explicit unit target, the orb
itself cast it on the owner. The pickup script cancelled the default effect only at hit-target and then had
the owner cast its own copy. The orb's copy replaced the owner's stacked aura (one Darkcasting per target
from different casters) and the owner's new copy replaced the orb's, so the result was always a fresh single
stack. A temporary diagnostic confirmed it: two pickups left 1 stack and reset the duration, while direct
casts stacked. The pickup script now runs at launch-target, so the stock trigger never fires and the owner's
own cast is the only one. Real Blood Orbs (creature 315303) are summoned on the player so the native pickup
pulse runs. DISCRIMINATING: three pickups give 3 stacks of the owner's own Darkcasting, one Darkcasting and
one Blood Orb cooldown cast per pickup. Before the fix every pickup left 1 stack.

steps.label: SETUP: pickup 1 casts the Blood Orb cooldown once
DISCRIMINATING: after pickup 1 the owner's Darkcasting has 1 stacks
SETUP: pickup 2 casts the Blood Orb cooldown once
DISCRIMINATING: after pickup 2 the owner's Darkcasting has 2 stacks
SETUP: pickup 3 casts the Blood Orb cooldown once
DISCRIMINATING: after pickup 3 the owner's Darkcasting has 3 stacks
DISCRIMINATING: no other copy of Darkcasting is on the owner
